context:
Goal: four lane PRs (#2737, #2770, #2875, #2920) take in main after batch 104, so they can join the next batch.
Problem (rule): the records-page guard refuses the merge until the lane takes main's docs/records.md, and the auto-mode check denies that step as a local delete that cannot be undone; only your typed override passes it.
Based on (read): lane fan-code-workflows hit both refusals on #2737 (coordinator, 15:01 CST).
Based on (read): the dropped row is derived; the merge tool rebuilds the records page at merge.
Departs from: main — the records-page guard blocks this lane's main merge — the lane makes the merge under your typed override, and step records-page-guard-derived-rows fixes the guard for later merges.

options.gain: The four PRs take in main now and can join the next batch.
options.how: Open the lane at https://claude.ai/code/session_013NEJL11UY3p6jnSXrTspmu and type `override 15m` there; it covers each refused act in that lane for 15 minutes, so all four merges.
options.label: Type the override in that lane (Recommended)
options.lose: One typed line from you; the guard stays as it is until its fix lands.

options.gain: No override; the guard is fixed first, so the next lane that merges main is not stuck either.

title: Type an override so lane fan-code-workflows can merge main into four PRs?
why: A guard and the auto-mode check disagree, so the lane cannot merge main without you.
